gloss: rectangular cut; cut into thin strips

definitions.gloss: rectangular cut; cut into thin rectangular strips
definitions.explanation: a cutting technique where ingredients are sliced into thin rectangular shapes resembling tanzaku (paper strips used for wishes)

examples.japanese: ⟦{大根|だいこん}→大根：05186_daikon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{短冊切|たんざくぎ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To cut the daikon into thin rectangles.

examples.japanese: {短冊切|たんざくぎ}りにした⟦{豆腐|とうふ}→豆腐：04928_toufu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: Add the rectangular-cut tofu to the miso soup.

examples.japanese: ⟦{炒|いた}め{物|もの}→炒め物：08537_itamemono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{短冊切|たんざくぎ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{適|てき}している→適する：02297_tekisuru⟧。
examples.english: Rectangular cuts are suitable for stir-fries.

notes:
{短冊切|たんざくぎ}り is a Japanese cutting technique that produces thin rectangular strips.

ETYMOLOGY:
Named after ⟦{短冊|たんざく}→短冊：13674_tanzaku⟧, the rectangular paper strips used for writing wishes during ⟦{七夕|たなばた}→七夕：05633_tanabata⟧ (Tanabata festival).

TYPICAL SIZE:
About 4-5 cm long, 1 cm wide, 5 mm thick.

COMMON VEGETABLES FOR THIS CUT:
- ⟦{大根|だいこん}→大根：05186_daikon⟧: daikon radish
- ⟦{人参|にんじん}→人参：05185_ninjin⟧: carrot
- ⟦{豆腐|とうふ}→豆腐：04928_toufu⟧: tofu
- ⟦こんにゃく→こんにゃく：04931_konnyaku⟧: konjac

SUITABLE DISHES:
- ⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧: miso soup
- ⟦{炒|いた}め{物|もの}→炒め物：08537_itamemono⟧: stir-fry
- ⟦{煮物|にもの}→煮物：04971_nimono⟧: simmered dishes

OTHER JAPANESE CUTTING TECHNIQUES:
- ⟦{千切|せんぎ}り→千切り：07473_sengiri⟧: julienne (thin strips)
- ⟦{乱切|らんぎ}り→乱切り：08067_rangiri⟧: random/rolling cut
- ⟦{輪切|わぎ}り→輪切り：07474_wagiri⟧: round slices
